summary: Tenant-scoped live audit stream with allow-list redaction, replayable resume tokens, and compliance attestation request
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a tenant-scoped, near-real-time audit event stream to their Splunk HEC endpoint that performs allow-list (field-level) redaction of PII at the event envelope level, preserves strict event ordering, and exposes replayable resume tokens for forensic replay. They also require a compliance attestation bundle proving redaction correctness and KMS key rotation evidence for the delivery channel.

Impact: Customer cannot complete SOC2 evidence package for upcoming audit until they can demonstrate per-event redaction proofs and resumable, ordered delivery. Current workaround (S3 dumps) does not meet streaming latency or evidence requirements.

Desired outcome: 1) Live HEC-forwarded audit stream with configurable allow-list redaction rules per tenant; 2) deterministic ordering with monotonic resume tokens (opaque to customer) to support replay and gap detection; 3) signed attestation bundle (HMAC manifest + list of redacted fields per event sample) and KMS rotation log exported to the customer for auditor review.

Background/context: FinEdge is an enterprise customer on an enterprise plan with strict audit controls. They onboarded with a standard webhook audit-capability but require field-level allowlisting (positive list) instead of redact-by-default because their internal auditors need proof that only allowed fields are present. They also need the ability to replay precisely from a resume token if an ingest window is missed.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer creates audit-subscription in Console for tenant 'finedge-prod-12' and selects 'Splunk HEC' delivery.
2) Customer config posts allowed_fields payload: ["event_id", "timestamp", "actor.id", "action", "resource.id"].
3) Customer observes events arriving at HEC with PII still present in nested 'request' object (email/address) and no resume tokens in delivery receipts.
4) Customer files this ticket and requests compliance artifacts.
logs: Sample event received by customer HEC (redaction expected): {"event_id":"evt_01F9Z1","timestamp":"2026-03-09T18:22:33Z","actor":{"id":"user_245","email":"jane.doe@finedge.com"},"action":"document.generate","resource":{"id":"doc_77","title":"Loan Agreement"},"request":{"ip":"3.14.15.9","address":"123 Main St","ssn":"***REDACTED***"}}
investigation_notes:
03-10 Priya: Validated subscription configuration in console for tenant finedge-prod-12. Delivery logs show webhook success (200) but payload contains unredacted nested fields under 'request'.
03-11 Diego: Reproduced locally with a simulated allowlist; found redaction service applied only at top-level keys due to current serializer path resolution bug (path resolver ignores dot-notation for nested allowlist).
03-12 SRE (Avery Chen): Confirmed delivery receipts do not include resume tokens. Delivery pipeline uses 'ack' but resume tokens were not wired into HEC forwarding header.
Hypothesis: Two bugs — (1) redaction engine does not evaluate nested dot-path allowlists, (2) resume token plumbing dropped when forwarding to 3rd-party HEC adapter. Both require code changes in audit-proxy and streaming-svc.
Observed logs: audit-proxy/error: path_resolver: unsupported path 'request.address' for tenant finedge-prod-12
Streaming-svc/info: forward_hec: outgoing_headers missing 'X-Resume-Token'
Related runbooks: /runbooks/audit-forwarding-troubleshoot
comments: Priya Kapoor (2026-03-10): Uploaded customer's allowlist JSON and sample unredacted event. Customer stresses audit deadline end of month.

Diego Morales (2026-03-11): Assigned to investigate redaction serializer. Found path-resolution bug; opened PR-87 on audit-proxy to fix dot-path evaluation. Marking as blocker for streaming resume work.

Avery Chen (SRE) (2026-03-12): Verified resume token missing in HEC adapter. Created streaming-svc PR-2143 to include X-Resume-Token header and manifest HMAC in delivery receipts. Planning deploy to staging for QA.

Customer (J. Martin, FinEdge) (2026-03-12): Appreciate the quick triage. Can you provide a temporary signed attest manifest for the last 7 days while patch is delivered? Auditor wants chain-of-custody evidence.
resolution_summary:
Workaround provided (in progress): Support exported a 7-day S3 archive with per-event redaction map and signed HMAC manifest for FinEdge auditors. This archive was generated by internal forensic job that applies the allowlist correctly and produces resume tokens for each event.
Next steps: 1) Merge and deploy audit-proxy PR-87 (dot-path allowlist fix) to staging and run regression suite; 2) Merge streaming-svc PR-2143 to ensure resume tokens are forwarded to HEC and included in delivery receipts; 3) Deliver formal compliance attestation bundle (signed manifest, KMS rotation logs, sample event redaction proofs) once both patches live in prod.
Target ETA for prod rollout: 2026-03-20. Customer notified and okayed temporary S3 artifact for auditor.
